schema.name: link
schema.description: Entity representing a personal link with URL, custom display name, and tracking timestamps for creation and updates

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for each link record

compliance.reason: Internal identifier for link management, not publicly exposed

fields.name: data_creator
fields.description: id of the user who creates the record

compliance.reason: Internal user identifier for audit trail purposes

fields.name: data_updater
fields.description: id of the user who updates the record

compliance.reason: Internal user identifier for audit trail purposes
Internal timestamp for record tracking and audit purposes
Internal timestamp for record tracking and audit purposes

fields.name: url
fields.description: The actual URL link stored in the system

compliance.reason: Personal link data that should be kept internal to the user

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Custom name or title for the link to display in the interface

compliance.reason: Personal label data that should be kept internal to the user
